entry: First post-Monday directional 1.618 resting limit per NY week; one opportunity per week and direction
confirmation: Immediate next timeframe candle after touch candle must CLOSE strictly inside 1.618. Touch candle may close outside; report its wick-only reclaim separately.
after_reclaim_stop: Exact entry until fee-inclusive stop can rest >=one tick behind a completed execution-period close; then tighten once to fee-inclusive stop.
target_activation: Resting full-position TP from fill; each target independent. A TP before confirmation is a valid target exit and separately counted.
censoring: Dataset end, conflicting input intervals and unobserved crypto paths are unresolved, not wins/losses. Any missing pre-confirmation observation censors before the gap.
range_ratio_anchor: From near Monday edge toward opposite edge; mirror for shorts
fee_basis: Owner-read OKX Lv1 rates applied individually to actual fills on historical Binance candles; entry/target maker, failed reclaim/stop taker.
gold: Excluded from fee-inclusive variant: actual spread and fees unknown. Original gross-only gold results retained.
control_protocol: Same symbol, NY week, direction and causal prior14-bar relative-volatility bucket. Random pre-entry closes; scale signal limit distance and target percentage, same NY-week monitoring cutoff/reclaim/fee semantics. Keep unfilled controls; compare complete matched groups and all opportunities separately.
comparison: Only reclaim protective stop changes; reuse frozen entry plans, five targets, confirmation periods, costs and random controls.
return_basis: Unlevered independent per-entry notional return, not R (no initial risk stop), not portfolio equity
owner_boundary_answer: 先保留开仓价止损，后续每根执行周期 K 线收盘达到可挂含费保本止损的位置后再移动
fee_breakeven_formula: (actual_entry_price + side * actual_entry_commission / filled_quantity) / (1 - side * taker_fee); round long up and short down to protection tick; account for native USDT commission rounding.
retry_clock: Every completed EXECUTION period candle (1m for6crypto assets,5m for626), not just confirmation timeframe.
replay_optimization: Only reclaimed positions can change; unchanged positions reuse original native fills. Keep every bar in submission-to-old-exit union; monotone tighter-stop bound checked. No new entry filtering, no new holding deadline.
compute: Mac only; no3060; full batch waits for original running parents; no source engine changes or baseline replay
